melee.description: Trained by fighting with blades. Higher levels hit more often and harder. Blades swing every {weapon_types:blade.attack_speed} ticks and are the steady, low-attention style.

firearms.description: Trained by fighting with pistols. Pistols fire every {weapon_types:pistol.attack_speed} ticks from up to {weapon_types:pistol.attack_range} tiles and use a gas cartridge per shot; shoot and step back to kite.

toughness.description: Your maximum HP equals your Toughness level. Every hit you land gives Toughness XP.

endurance.description: Makes you harder to hit. Trained by switching combat XP to Endurance in the Gear tab. Armor adds to it.

salvaging.description: Gathering: click a node to work it until it's stripped or your inventory is full.

siphoning.description: Gathering: click a node to work it until it's stripped or your inventory is full.

xenobiology.description: Gathering: click a node to work it until it's stripped or your inventory is full.

engineering.description: Manufacturing: weapons, ammo and empty injectors at the weapons bench, armor and canisters at the metal press. XP comes from the materials used, the same per unit whatever you make.

splicing.description: Manufacturing from living things, at the bio-still: healing injectors distilled from ventbloom and ichor. XP comes from the materials, the same per unit.
